title: Regulatory Request Concierge and Risk-Weighted Prioritization Flow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a high volume of heterogeneous security and compliance asks (SOC2 questionnaires, GDPR/DPA clarifications, HIPAA scoping, custom vendor questionnaires). Right now these are routed manually to different teams which increases SLA variance and creates duplicate work. This ticket proposes a single Regulatory Request Concierge flow that synthesizes signals from the request, scores risk/effort, and routes to the correct lane (self-serve, solutions, legal, or expedited SLA) with pre-populated evidence bundles and a clear prioritization outcome.

Scope: design, API/console integration, classification model (rules + heuristics), routing rules, evidence pack templates, and an escalation policy for high-risk or high-cost requests. This is non-bug product work focused on intake, prioritization, and enterprise triage for security & compliance asks.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A routing service that classifies incoming requests into: self-serve, standard review (3-5 business days), expedited (24-48 hours), or legal escalation.
2) Risk-weighted score computed from data sensitivity, regulatory scope, customer tier, and operational impact. Score and routing visible in the Console request view.
3) Automated evidence pack suggestions for common asks (SOC2 controls, DPA clauses, data residency statements) with links to canonical artifacts.
4) Audit trail and SLA timer per request; owners can reassign and annotate.
5) Metrics dashboard: intake rate, time-to-first-response, percent escalated, and classifier precision/recall.
6) End-to-end test that simulates 500 varied requests and confirms routing distribution within expected thresholds.
proposed_rubric:
Risk-weighted priority score (0-100) computed as: 
- Data sensitivity (0-40): None=0, PII=20, Regulated PHI=35, Highly regulated industrial data=40.
- Regulatory scope (0-25): None=0, Local privacy=10, GDPR/DPA=15, HIPAA=20, SOC2-audit=25.
- Customer tier (0-15): Self-serve=0, SMB=5, Midmarket=10, Enterprise=15.
- Operational effort estimate (0-10): auto-evidence=0, minor config=3, engineering change=7, cross-team project=10.
- Historical frictions multiplier (x1 or x1.25): if similar request previously required legal remediation, multiply by 1.25.
Routing thresholds: 0-24 => Self-serve; 25-49 => Standard review; 50-74 => Expedited; 75+ => Legal escalation.
Notes: The rubric is intentionally hybrid (deterministic rules + allow ML model to propose a preliminary mapping). We surface the drivers and let operators override.

risks: Classifier false negatives causing under-escalation (legal exposure)
Over-automation may frustrate enterprise customers who expect human contact on complex asks
Evidence pack accuracy: wrong artifact suggestions could increase admin overhead
Dependency on message bus schema change could delay routing rollout
mitigations: Add mandatory human review for any request that mentions regulatory keywords or comes from Enterprise tier until model precision > 90%
Expose one-click 'Request human review' in Console for any routed request
Maintain a canonical artifact registry owned by Legal and Solutions and mark artifacts with versioning
Ship the score as metadata first to enable partial rollout while bus schema change is coordinated
